channel.title: Aggregation on The Art of PostgreSQL
channel.description: Recent content in Aggregation on The Art of PostgreSQL

item.title: What is an SQL Aggregate?
item.description: It’s the reduce half of map/reduce: an aggregate computes a single result per group, and GROUP BY defines the groups.

item.title: The FILTER Clause: Multiple Counts in One Pass
item.description: count(*) FILTER (WHERE condition) computes conditional aggregates without CASE expressions or separate subqueries — one scan, multiple results.

item.title: percentile_cont(): Many Percentiles in One Query
item.description: Median, 90th, 95th, and 99th percentile — computed together in a single pass with an ordered-set aggregate.
